title: Strict coordinate composition of representative Roos comparisons
statement: For additive functors E,F,G between abelian categories with countable products, an ordinary associator E⋙F≅G, strict towers X,Y,Z,W and an output tower map m:Z→W, RepresentativeComposition records the second comparison on the first arithmetic subsequence. Its fields prescribe the selected finite-stage maps, the horizontal equality of actual signed Roos maps, the arithmetic block/selection map and its square and composition equation. This is the existing structure extracted verbatim from the completion coherence module.

structure RepresentativeComposition
    {A : Type xA} [Category.{yA} A] [Abelian A] [HasCountableProducts A]
    {B : Type xB} [Category.{yB} B] [Abelian B] [HasCountableProducts B]
    {D : Type xD} [Category.{yD} D] [Abelian D] [HasCountableProducts D]
    {E : A ⥤ B} [E.Additive] {F : B ⥤ D} [F.Additive] {G : A ⥤ D} [G.Additive]
    (α : E ⋙ F ≅ G)
    (X : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ) (Y : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B) ℤ)
    (Z W : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ D) ℤ) (m : Z ⟶ W)
    (e f : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (ra : RepresentativeRoosComparison E X Y e)
    (rb : RepresentativeRoosComparison F Y Z f)
    (rba : RepresentativeRoosComparison G X W (e * f))
